CustomField.description: Heading text for the edit modal opened from a Repeater or Table row. Passed as edit-modal-heading to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Shown when Enable Edit Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The title shown at the top of the popup that opens when a user edits a row. Requires Enable Edit Action; leave blank for the default heading.
CustomField.label: Modal Title
